extracted.intended_audience: policymakers, IP office staff, researchers, and analysts interested in industrial design/IP statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Compilation of standardized metrics and charts presenting global industrial design application and registration statistics (2009–2023) including breakdowns by office, origin, Locarno class, sector, and procedural/office performance indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: C1. Trend in industrial design applications worldwide, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows total industrial design applications and annual growth rates worldwide for 2009–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: From 2017 onwards, industrial design application data provided by the IP office of China include only those applications for which the necessary application fees have been paid. Because China accounts for most of the global total, this means it is not possible to report the 2017 worldwide application growth rate. World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices. These totals include applications filed directly with national and regional offices (the Paris route) and designations received via the Hague System (where applicable). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C2. Trend in application design counts worldwide, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows application design counts (counting designs contained in applications) and growth rates worldwide for 2009–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: From 2017 onwards, China’s application data include only applications with fees paid. World totals are WIPO estimates covering 157 IP offices and include Paris route and Hague System design counts. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C3. Resident and non-resident application design counts worldwide, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of application design counts into resident and non-resident shares and shows trends 2009–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices; includes Paris route and Hague System. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C4. Trend in industrial design registrations worldwide, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows total industrial design registrations and annual growth rates worldwide for 2009–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices and include registrations issued for Paris route filings and Hague System designations (where applicable). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C5. Trend in registration design counts worldwide, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows registration design counts (designs contained in registrations) and growth rates worldwide for 2009–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices and include Paris route and Hague System figures. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C6. Resident and non-resident registration design counts worldwide, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of registration design counts into resident and non-resident shares and trends 2009–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices; includes Paris route and Hague System. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C7. Application design counts by region, 2013 and 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts by geographical region in 2013 and 2023, showing resident share, share of world total and average growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: Totals by region are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices. Regions include specified number of offices (Africa 37, Asia 43, Europe 42, Latin America and the Caribbean 27, Northern America 2, Oceania 6). See data description section for region classification. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C8. Trend in industrial design applications for the top five offices, 1883–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Long-term trend in industrial design applications for the top five offices (selected based on 2023 totals) across 1883–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data are based on numbers of applications filed; differences between single-design and multiple-design filing systems across offices are not taken into account. Note on China: decrease in 2017 likely explained by change in counting method starting 2017 (only fee-paid applications). Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C9. Application design counts for the top 20 offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts in 2023 for the top 20 IP offices, with resident vs non-resident shares and non-resident share percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EUIPO refers to the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Data are counts of applications filed; differences in filing systems across offices are not normalized. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C10. Contribution of resident and non-resident application design counts to total growth for the top 20 offices, 2022–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows total growth in application design counts for top 20 offices and breaks growth down by contributions from resident and non-resident applicants (2022–2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example explained: total design counts in China increased by 3.5%, with resident applicants contributing 3.3 percentage points and non-resident 0.2 points. EUIPO = European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C11. Application design counts for offices of selected low- and middle-income countries, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts in 2023 for selected offices from low- and middle-income countries, including resident vs non-resident breakdown and non-resident share percent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected offices span different regions and income groups. ARIPO, EAPO, OAPI noted where relevant. Full data available in statistical table C37. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C12. Contribution of resident and non-resident application design counts to total growth for offices of selected low- and middle-income countries, 2022–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows 2022–2023 total growth in design counts for selected low- and middle-income offices, broken down into resident and non-resident contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected offices span different regions and income groups; full data in table C37. Example explained in text. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C13. Registration design counts for the top 20 offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration design counts in 2023 for the top 20 offices, with growth rates and resident/non-resident breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EUIPO refers to the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C14. Registration design counts for offices of selected low- and middle-income countries, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Registration design counts in 2023 for selected low- and middle-income offices, plus growth rates and resident/non-resident breakdowns.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected offices are from different regions and income groups; data for many offices presented in statistical tables C38. ARIPO, EAPO, OAPI referenced. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C15. Non-resident application design counts by filing route, 2009–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of non-resident application design counts by filing route (direct vs via the Hague System) from 2009–2023, with Hague share percent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes the two filing routes for non-resident activity. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C16. Application design counts for the top 20 origins, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts in 2023 for the top 20 origins (based on residence of the first named applicant), showing resident versus abroad counts and growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Origin is determined by residence of first named applicant. An application filed at a regional office is resident if the applicant resides in one of that office’s member states. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C17. Application design counts for selected low- and middle-income origins, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts in 2023 for selected low- and middle-income origins, broken into resident and abroad and showing growth rates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected origins span different world regions and income groups; full data available in table C37. Origin determined by residence of first named applicant; regional office filings may be considered resident where applicable. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C18. Trend in application design counts abroad worldwide, 2013–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows trends and growth rates for application design counts filed abroad worldwide (2013–2023).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: World totals are WIPO estimates using data covering 157 IP offices; includes Paris and Hague routes. See glossary for definition of design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C19. Application design counts abroad for the top 20 origins, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts filed abroad in 2023 for the top 20 origins, with growth rates and counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Origin determined by residence of first named applicant; regional filings considered resident if applicant resides in member states. See glossary. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C20. Equivalent application design counts abroad for the top 20 origins, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Equivalent application design counts abroad in 2023 for top 20 origins; accounts for equivalence where regional filings represent multiple member-state applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications filed at some regional offices are considered equivalent to multiple applications in member states. See glossary for definition of equivalent application and design count. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C21. Flows of application design counts abroad for the top five origins and the top 10 offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Flows matrix showing where applicants from the top five origins filed abroad, and which top 10 offices received those applications in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EUIPO is the European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C22. Application design counts for the top 10 Locarno classes, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts and share (%) in 2023 for the top 10 Locarno classes (e.g., furnishing, clothing, packaging, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Based on data from 119 IP offices. Note that data for several larger offices (Japan, US) may be not available or incomplete. See annex C for Locarno class numbers. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C23. Application design counts by industry sector, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Application design counts and share (%) in 2023 by industry sector, using an OECD concordance of Locarno classes into 12 sectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concordance by OECD converted 32 Locarno classes into 12 industry sectors (see annex C for definitions). Figures based on data from 119 IP offices; data for several larger offices may be incomplete. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C24. Distribution of application design counts by the top three sectors for the top 10 offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution (%) of application design counts across the top three industry sectors for each of the top 10 offices in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Top three sectors and top 10 offices selected based on 2023 totals. OECD concordance used; data for larger offices (Japan, US) may be incomplete. EUIPO = European Union Intellectual Property Office. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C25. Distribution of application design counts by the top three sectors for the top 10 origins, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution (%) of application design counts across the top three industry sectors for each of the top 10 origins in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OECD concordance used to convert classes into industry sectors. Data based on 119 IP offices; some larger offices' data may be incomplete. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C26. Resident application design count per USD 100 billion of GDP for the top 20 origins, 2013 and 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application design counts normalized per USD 100 billion GDP for the top 20 origins, comparing 2013 and 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: GDP data are in constant 2021 US PPP dollars. Origins selected based on top application design counts and GDP availability. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C27. Resident application design count per million population for the top 20 origins, 2013 and 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Resident application design counts per million population for the top 20 origins, comparing 2013 and 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Origins selected by top application design counts and population data availability. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C28. Resident application design count per capita and GDP per capita for selected origins, 2019–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Scatter/relationship of resident application design count per capita versus GDP per capita (PPP constant 2021 USD) for selected origins across 2019–2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected origins span different regions and income groups. GDP per capita shown on log scale. Sources: WIPO Statistics Database and World Bank, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C29. Trend in industrial design registrations in force worldwide, 2013–2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Trend and growth rates of industrial design registrations in force worldwide for 2013–2023 (number in force, not number of designs in those registrations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO estimates cover 138 IP offices and include direct national/regional applications plus Hague System designations. Data refer to number of registrations in force. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C30. Industrial design registrations in force for the top 20 offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of industrial design registrations in force in 2023 for the top 20 offices (counts of registrations in force, not designs contained).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EUIPO = European Union Intellectual Property Office. Data refer to number of registrations in force, not number of designs within those registrations. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C31. Industrial design registrations in force in 2023 as a percentage of total registrations (by registration year)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of designs registered in year t that remain in force in 2023, plotted by registration year (based on data from 81 offices).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages calculated using designs registered in year t and still in force in 2023 divided by total designs registered in year t. Based on 81 offices with breakdowns available. Industrial design rights generally last up to 15 years (10 years in China), China excluded from this figure due to dominance of totals. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C32. Average age of industrial design registrations in force at selected offices, 2018 and 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Average age (years) of industrial design registrations in force at selected offices for 2018 and 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EUIPO = European Union Intellectual Property Office. Percentages/calculations use registrations by year in force in 2023. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C33. Distribution of industrial design examination outcomes for selected offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution (%) of examination outcomes (Registered, Rejected, Withdrawn/abandoned) for selected offices in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WIPO collects data from offices using a common questionnaire and methodology. However, because of differences in industrial design procedures between offices, data cannot be fully harmonized; exercise caution when comparing across offices. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C34. Potentially pending applications for selected offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of potentially pending industrial design applications at selected offices in 2023 (number of potentially pending applications reported by each office).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These counts reflect potentially pending applications as reported by offices; context/example in text highlights offices with relatively low numbers compared to filing activity. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C35. Average pendency times from filing date to first office action and to final decision at selected offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Average time (days) from filing to first office action and from filing to final decision (or from first office action to final decision) for selected offices in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example guidance from text: EUIPO average processing under five days; Thailand 915 days from filing to processing; average time between first office action and final decision less than one day at EUIPO and France, but 455 days in Thailand. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C36. Number of industrial design examiners for selected offices, 2023
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of industrial design examiners employed at selected offices in 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Counts are office-reported; used to contextualize procedural capacity/pendency metrics. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C37. Industrial design applications by office and origin, 2023 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical table providing detailed application counts by office and origin for 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive table referenced for detailed office-origin breakdowns. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C38. Industrial design registrations by office and origin, and registrations in force, 2023 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical table with registration counts by office and origin and counts of registrations in force for 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive table referenced for detailed office-origin registration breakdowns. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: C39. Industrial design office procedural data, 2023 (statistical table)
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistical table providing detailed procedural data reported by offices for 2023 (e.g., examination outcomes, pendency, examiners, pending applications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive table referenced for in-depth procedural metrics; data collected via WIPO questionnaire and subject to harmonization caveats. Source: WIPO Statistics Database, August 2024.
